# Finding Parking in South Lake Union

If you are only visiting The Center for Wooden Boats, please avoid parking in Daniel's Broiler's lot (just east of the pavilion) so it stays available for restaurant customers.

## ADA Accessible/Handicap Parking

Accessible parking is in MOHAI's lot next to the museum during business hours; the lot also serves visitor drop-off. During museum hours, use the callbox at the gate near The Center for Wooden Boats to gain access. See MOHAI's website for full instructions.

[visit mohai's website for ada parking instructions]()

[DOWNLOAD THIS PARKING GUIDE]()

## Pay by Phone/Meter Street Parking

- Rates: $0.50 – $3.00 per hour
- Time limits: usually 2 – 4 hours
- Free after 6 PM and all day Sundays
- Commonly found along Eastlake Ave E, Westlake Ave N, and south of Valley St and Mercer St
- A Pay by Phone lot in front of the Wagner Education Center fills up quickly

[find street parking]()

[pay by phone website]()

## Paid Parking Garages

- Rates: $7.00 – $15.00; time limits vary
- 500 9th Ave N
- 550 Boren
- 500 Boren Ave
- One garage has no time limit, approx. $10 for 5 hours
